med-pharma-clinical-trial-design v1.0.0 – Initial release

- Provides structured assistance for clinical trial protocol design tailored to pharmaceutical R&D needs.
- Supports inputs such as indication, intervention, study phase, objectives, design, population, endpoints, and visit schedule.
- Offers guidance aligned with the protocol design section of the referenced Clinical Trial Protocol Skill.
- Accepts a variety of input file formats (JSON, CSV, XLSX, DOCX, PDF, images via OCR) for flexible workflow integration.
- Requires API-based inference using the specified internal medical language model (no local fallback).
- Delivers standardized JSON outputs with both structured data and natural language explanations.
